title: Role-scoped keys: UX runbook and wireframes
content:
PURPOSE:
Quick runbook and low-fi wireframes for role-scoped API keys + service account UX. Focus: let org admins create short-lived keys scoped to specific roles and routes, view usage in audit logs, and manage rotation without exposing full org-level keys. This is a working doc — lots of open questions below.

BACKGROUND / WHY:
- Customers repeatedly ask for safer API key patterns: ability to issue keys with least privilege and short TTLs (hosted + private).
- Current console supports org keys + service accounts but users often create overly-broad tokens and keep them forever.
- Goal: reduce blast radius by making role-scoped keys the easy default, surface telemetry in audit view, and add simple rotation/expiration UX.

PRIMARY USERS / PERSONAS:
- Org Admin (owner of billing / security): needs auditability, revoke, and policy enforcement.
- Team Lead / Developer: needs quick dev keys scoped to routes for CI, testing.
- Platform / SecOps: needs rotation and KMS link, automation-friendly outputs (json).

SCENARIOS TO SUPPORT (happy path):
1) Admin creates a "reporting" role-scoped key that only allows embeddings and has 30d TTL.
2) Dev creates a short-lived (1h) key scoped to a single route and attaches to CI job.
3) Platform revokes compromised key and rotates to a new key that preserves same role bindings.
4) Auditor filters audit log for keys created in last 7 days and sees usage per route.

CONSTRAINTS / GUIDING PRINCIPLES:
- Default should be least privilege: pre-populate scopes derived from common templates rather than full org scope.
- Make ephemeral keys discoverable in CLI/SDK flows (copy-once pattern + download JSON).
- Minimize modal depth: key creation should be 1 modal with 3 vertical sections (who, what, TTL).
- Accessibility and copy: clearly communicate expiration and rotation implications.

WIREFRAME NOTES (low-fi sketches — use these as input for high-fidelity designs):
-- Create Key modal (single-column stack) --
[Title] Create role-scoped key
[Section] 1) Identity
  - Radio: Issue as Service Account / User-scoped (choose SA or personal)
  - Dropdown: Select service account ("new -> create inline")
[Section] 2) Scopes (primary UX)
  - Multiselect chips: generation, embeddings, rerank, admin:models (greyed if incompatible)
  - Route scoping: optional text field to add route pattern (e.g. /v1/generate/*)
  - Template buttons: "Dev CI (1h)", "Reporting (30d, embeddings)", "Integration (90d)"
[Section] 3) Policies & TTL
  - TTL picker: 1h/8h/1d/7d/30d/custom (warning copy if >90d)
  - Checkbox: "Require MFA for use" (ORG-only)
[Footer] Copy-once token area (masked by default) + Download JSON button + Revoke/Rotate CTA after creation

-- Keys list (table) --
Columns: name | owner | scopes | created | expires | last_used | status | actions
Row actions: copy, download, rotate, revoke, view in audit
Row chip states: expired (muted), active (green), at-risk (yellow if last_used from new IP)

-- Service Account flow (inline creation) --
Mini modal: name, description, attach default roles (checkbox list), primary owner. Option to attach KMS key.
Default to "no owner" for machine accounts; require explicit owner for long TTLs.

AUDIT LOG VIEW ENHANCEMENTS (filters + UX):
- Add filter: "Key ID / Key name" and "Service account".
- Add histogram for key issue events and usage spikes (7/30/90d).
- Event rows: timestamp | actor | action (create/copy/use/revoke/rotate) | key fingerprint | route | IP | geo
- Quick action inline: revoke key (opens confirm), open key details, jump to related policy.
- Saveable filter views: "Recent key creations" and "Keys used from unknown IPs"

MICROCOPY / HELP TEXT SAMPLES:
- TTL picker helper: "Shorter TTLs reduce blast radius. We recommend 1h for CI jobs and 30d for integrations."
- Copy-once box: "This token is shown once. Save the downloaded JSON to your secure vault. You can rotate later."
- Revoke confirmation: "Revoking this key will immediately stop all requests using it. This action cannot be undone."

POLICY & PERMISSIONS MAPPING (UX decs):
- Create an internal mapping: roles -> allowed endpoints + allowed model classes. Shown in a collapsed accordion in the Create Key modal so admins can inspect what they are granting.
- Allow "deny list" patterns for sensitive routes (e.g., anything with admin:model-write).

OPEN QUESTIONS / DECISIONS NEEDED:
- Default TTL for service-account-issued keys when created via API vs console. (API should allow longer by default?) JIRA RDW-4021
- Do we enforce org-level policy that forbids keys > X days (security policy)? How surfaced in UI?
- How to represent combined role permissions (e.g., embeddings + generate) in compact chip UX without confusing users?
- Should rotate preserve key ID (for audit continuity) or create new key with mapping record? (ops concern)

BACKLOG / ACTION ITEMS (owners + rough estimates):
- RDW-4078: Implement Create Key modal skeleton (Priya) — 2 sp
- RDW-4084: Keys list table + filters (Jordan) — 3 sp
- RDW-4090: Audit log filter + revoke action (SRE + Product) — 3 sp
- RDW-4102: CLI output for ephemeral keys (Mateo) — 2 sp
- UX: Produce hi-fi screens from low-fi here (Hannah) — 5 days

SAFETY / EDGE CASES TO TEST:
- Token leakage: ensure copy-once + masked UI, and server side log when token displayed (to surface accidental exposures).
- Downgrade flow: what happens if a key's role is reduced — preserve last_used and ensure immediate enforcement.
- Cross-account keys: disallow issuing key scoped to role belonging to another org.

NOTES / DISCUSSION BLIPS (from Slack #product-console):
- @sasha: prefer explicit "purpose" field on creation to make audit context richer (good for security reviews).
- @jordan: add indicator for keys that are used by CI (detect via user-agent heuristics) so admins can find them quickly.

NEXT UX DECISIONS FOR ASYNC REVIEW:
- Choose default TTL presets (1h/8h/30d/90d) and label them by use-case.
- Confirm copy-once flow: will we allow a later "reveal" after admin confirmation? (security trade-off).
- Decide whether to attach last rotation metadata to key details (yes preferred).

QUICK ASCII WIREFRAME (copy into figma as starting artboard):
[ Create key ]
+-----------------------------------------+
| Create role-scoped key                  |
| --------------------------------------  |
| Identity: [Service Account v] [+ create] |
| Scopes: [embeddings] [generate] [rerank] |
| Route pattern: [ /v1/generate/*        ] |
| TTL: [30d v]  [checkbox: require MFA ]   |
| [Create and download]  [Cancel]         |
+-----------------------------------------+

FINAL NOTE: this doc is intentionally light on copy polish — main goal is to capture UX surface area and decisions so engineers can start building a prototype. Please add comments inline and tag with JIRA ids for any scope changes.

PRIORITY TAG: high (security + onboarding impact)
